outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured confocal micrographs (time-lapse images of photoactivation) rather than a plot summarizing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows time-course scatter/line plots of normalized fluorescence intensity vs. time (with fitted model curves), for each of H1.1, RCC1 and H1t. The main plots already display the raw individual measurements as scattered points, and the insets show the averaged early time-course responses as time-series points with error bars. Both the main plots (raw scatter data) and insets (averaged time-course/line-type data) fall into plot categories (scatter plots and line/time-course plots) that are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual data points, since overlaying all underlying replicate traces on a time series would make the plot unreadable and the raw scatter points in the main panels already constitute the individual data.
